content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring), which was issued because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9. The note states that, given the paroxysmal nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events. We submit this documentation for episode ep-05049 in support of the medical necessity of the service."}
